name: Love And Relationships
overview: Scripture reveals that love and relationships are grounded in commitment, selflessness, and obedience to God's design. Jacob's dedicated love for Rachel exemplifies personal devotion, while Jesus teaches the surpassing command to love others as oneself and to love one another as He loved us, highlighting sacrificial and unconditional love. Marriage is affirmed as a divine union where a man and woman become one flesh, underscoring the permanence and unity intended by God. Furthermore, the believer's conduct is shaped by avoiding ungodly influences and embracing godly love in all relationships.
